info.title: DFARS 252 227 7013 7014 7017 Data Rights Assertion API
info.description: Audits software components, AI/ML models and weights, firmware, technical data packages, and CDRL deliverables by development funding history (100% private expense, SBIR/STTR, mixed funding, or government-funded) to generate a 4-column DFARS 252.227-7017 Data Rights Assertion Table, verbatim DFARS 252.227-7013/7014/7018 and FAR 52.227-14 restrictive marking legends, and a 10 U.S.C. 4401 Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA) boundary plan. Stateless, read-only, and idempotent.

post.summary: Generate DFARS 252.227-7017 / FAR 52.227-14 IP & Data Rights Assertion Table
post.description: Generates a 4-column DFARS 252.227-7017 / FAR 52.227-14 IP & Data Rights Assertion Table, verbatim restrictive marking legends, and a 10 U.S.C. 4401 MOSA boundary protection plan.

software_modules_and_cdrl_deliverables_t.description: Inventory of software components, AI/ML models, weights, firmware, technical data packages, and CDRL deliverables with their development funding history (100% private expense, mixed funding, SBIR/STTR, or government-funded).

governing_acquisition_regime.description: Applicable IP clause framework: DoD DFARS 252.227-7013/7014/7015/7017/7018 (SBIR) or Civilian FAR 52.227-14 / 52.227-19.

modular_open_systems_approach_mosa_conte.description: 10 U.S.C. 4401 Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA) interface strategy separating open APIs/form-fit-function data from proprietary source code and model weights.

example.software_modules_and_cdrl_deliverables_t: 1. SentinelCore Zero-Trust Inference Engine & Pre-Trained Weights v4.2: Developed 100% at private expense (2022-2025 IR&D GL Account #8410) prior to solicitation; delivered as compiled container image under CDRL A004. 2. Tactical RF Sensor Ingestion Firmware: Developed under DoD SBIR Phase II Contract FA8650-24-C-1102; delivered under CDRL A005. 3. Mission Adapter Microservice & REST/gRPC Interface Control Document (ICD): Developed with mixed/contract funding under CLIN 0002; delivered under CDRL A002 (ICD) and CDRL A006 (Adapter Source).
